# Original Photo Evaluation Dataset Attribution

All 14 images in `tests/fixtures/original_photos/` are unedited original photographs (resized locally to max 720px for repository test fixtures, with no color grading or synthetic filters applied) sourced from Wikimedia Commons for evaluating Stage A (YuNet face/landmark detection), Stage B (salient subject segmentation), and Stage C (skin/lighting heuristics).
